title: Confirmation companies
subtitle: Companies that call your customers and confirm their orders. You agree on their price and pay them directly.
search_placeholder: Search by name, email or phone...
remove_confirm: Remove {{name}} from your list? Orders already sent stay with them.
empty_saved: Your list is empty — find a confirmation company and save it to send it orders.
how_1: Save one or more companies to your list.
how_2: On the orders page, select orders → "Send for confirmation".
how_3: The company calls the customer and edits the order; once confirmed it is uploaded to your default delivery account automatically.
how_4: You pay the company directly at its listed price, outside the platform.
send_no_saved: No companies in your list yet.
send_skipped: {{count}} skipped (already sent or status not allowed)
recall_none: These orders can't be recalled now (being handled or not sent)
send_skipped_digital: {{count}} digital orders not sent — digital orders can't be sent for confirmation
auto_desc: Every new order is sent straight to the confirmation company you choose, with no action needed from you.
ship_account_hint: Orders this company confirms are uploaded automatically to the delivery account you choose.
ship_account_none: Add a delivery company account in settings first
